commit.message:
[security][CVE-2018-6334] kill globals for file uploads in hhvm

Code should look at _GET, _POST, _FILES, etc. directly to avoid security concerns.

This included both `$GLOBALS` and `register_globals`-like behavior.

CVE-2018-6334
